newsitem.title: USA: DCI Telecommunications in merger talks.
newsitem.headline: DCI Telecommunications in merger talks.

text.p: DCI Telecommunications Inc said Monday it was in merger talks with telecommunications services company American Cash Card Corp.
The merger, as initially proposed, would be a non-taxable deal involving DCI Telecommunications stock. The deal would be designed to minimize dilution to shareholders, the company said.
The two firms hired an investment banking firm to review the deal, give a "fairness" opinion and provide financing to grow the company, DCI said.

DCI said it plans to consolidate certain manufacturing and programming services in the New Jersey facility, while enhancing product development and profitability between R&D Scientific, Alpha Products, and American Cash Card.
American Cash Card posted 1995 sales in excess of $21 million.
